newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves Coca-Cola unit investment.
newsitem.headline: India approves Coca-Cola unit investment.

text.p: The Indian Industry Ministry said on Thursday that it had approved a 4.4 billion rupee ($123 million) investment by Britco Foods Co Beverages Ltd, a wholly owned unit of U.S. soft drinks maker Coca-Cola Co.
The ministry announced the approval in a list of 61 foreign direct investment proposals which it said would attract some 7.75 billion rupees in foreign investment.
A Coca-Cola official in the Indian capital said the investment was for a plant in Pune, in the western state of Maharashtra, and would primarily be used in making cans and plastic bottles.
